It enables us to take a systematic quantitative structured approach to the problem of managing a project through to successful completion.Two types(PERT and CPM)\r\n\r\nA linear programming problem (LP) is an optimization problem for which We attempt to maximize (or minimize) a linear function of the decision\r\nvariables. (objective function)\r\n\r\nThe critical path method (CPM) is an algorithm for scheduling a set of project activities. It is an important tool for effective project management. the term is generally applied to any approach used to analyze a project network logic diagram.\r\n\r\nIn an optimization problem, a slack variable is a variable that is added to an inequality constraint to transform it to an equality. \r\n\r\nPERT is an acronym for Program Evaluation and Review Techniques. A program\r\n(a synonym for a project) is represented by a network of nodes and arrows that are\r\nthen evaluated to determine the critical activities, improve the schedule if necessary,\r\nand review progress once the project is undertaken.\r\n\r\nA Gantt chart is an easy way to schedule tasks. It is a chart on which bars represent\r\neach task or activity.The length of each bar represents the relative length of the task.\r\n\r\nSlack time is defined as the temporal difference between the deadline, the ready time and the run time.\r\n\r\nA transport model is a model that helps in solving a transportation problem (Which is the problem of transporting various amounts of single homogeneous comodity, from origins to destinations at a minimum total transportation cost).","apiResponse":null,"schedule":null,"delivered":"2012-09-11 11:27:18","msgStatus":"Sent","unitsUsed":"16.50","smsCreated":"2012-09-11 10:27:18","channel":"Website","delivery_report":null,"dlvrID":"#y134735923533#","apiDlvrID":""}, {"msgID":"1541","msgClientID":"81","senderID":"Alli","recipients":"2347065381134","message":"You advice companies based on your result for your objective value(p)...
